change.description: Reuse CPU-side byte-vector storage for recurring captured linear R8 video planes in the live plugin path.
change.fallback: When the bounded cache cannot admit a plane, the existing conversion path allocates an ordinary vector.
change.upload_lifetime: The renderer copies texture bytes into its own Vulkan staging input before the draw preparation call returns; the ring worker then recycles the CPU payload.

host_build.initial_build_note: A first clean host build missed the SDK's required -mssse3 flag. The project plugin source compiled after configuring that host-only flag; no SDK sources were changed.

android_device_check.result: passed: captured R8 upload scratch reuse check passed

language_selector.cause: The shader translator collapsed nonzero Xenos interpolator exports to Vulkan location 0; the language font shader reads the value from interpolator location 1.
language_selector.current_candidate_observation: All six retail language labels are legible in the live Redmi selector screenshot, including the gray unselected entries.

limits: The regression verifies CPU buffer reuse, not Bink playback rate.
No fresh retail run with this optimization was made; no live frame-time or allocation-count improvement is claimed.
The current Android live candidate has the language-selector fix, but the video-plane scratch change was checked with its standalone ARM64 regression, not installed into the game.
Host CTest validation does not prove full retail parity.
